Population increased in North Northamptonshire

The estimated population of North Northamptonshire in 2024 was 373,871 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that North Northamptonshire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North Northamptonshire increased by 3.7%.

Over this slightly longer period, North Northamptonshire was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North Northamptonshire

The average (median) age stayed at 41 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North Northamptonshire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North Northamptonshire is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North Northamptonshire's population of 373,871 usual residents was made up of:

  • 73,300 people aged 0 to 15 years, (19.6%)
  • 231,724 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62%)
  • 68,847 people aged 65 years and over, (18.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North Northamptonshire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (19.6% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North Northamptonshire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North Northamptonshire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North Northamptonshire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 243 people (0.1%). In total, there were 3,596 births and 3,353 deaths in North Northamptonshire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 3,513 (1%). There were 17,403 people entering the area and 13,890 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North Northamptonshire's population of 1,640 (0.4%) as a result of 3,840 people entering the area and 2,200 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North Northamptonshire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North Northamptonshire in mid-2023 is 368,282.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 982 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 691 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 291 people.
